dataset: Codex Conditions official respiratory etiology B23
policy: Fill only currently empty bilingual etiology fields for five respiratory Conditions. Preserve existing pathology, risks, red flags, acupuncture scope, relations, and provenance; append direct government or NHS sources. Keep umbrella diagnoses distinct from specific diseases, avoid converting risk associations into individual causation, and preserve exposure and emergency diagnostic boundaries.

cond.bronchiectasis.etiology_zh: 支氣管擴張症的共同終點是支氣管壁永久受損與擴張，但起始原因異質。嚴重或反覆呼吸道感染可直接破壞氣道；囊性纖維化、原發性纖毛運動障礙等先天疾病會使黏液纖毛清除失效；常見變異性免疫缺乏等免疫問題則增加反覆感染。其他已知原因包括 allergic bronchopulmonary aspergillosis、類風濕性關節炎或 Sjögren 症候群等系統性發炎疾病、慢性誤吸，以及腫瘤或吸入異物造成的局部阻塞。受損氣道清除黏液的能力下降，黏液滯留促進微生物定殖與感染，後續中性球性發炎、組織破壞和重塑又進一步惡化清除，形成感染—發炎—損傷的惡性循環；感染既可能是起因，也可能是疾病建立後的加重因素。成人也可合併 COPD、氣喘或發炎性腸病，但共存不等於每例的直接病因。相當一部分病例經系統評估仍找不到原因，稱為 idiopathic bronchiectasis；局限單一肺葉時尤其要排除局部阻塞。
cond.bronchiectasis.etiology_en: Bronchiectasis is a common endpoint of permanent bronchial-wall injury and dilatation, but its initiating causes are heterogeneous. Severe or recurrent respiratory infection can directly injure airways. Congenital disorders such as cystic fibrosis and primary ciliary dyskinesia impair mucociliary clearance, while immune disorders such as common variable immunodeficiency promote recurrent infection. Other established causes include allergic bronchopulmonary aspergillosis, systemic inflammatory disease such as rheumatoid arthritis or Sjögren syndrome, chronic aspiration, and focal obstruction from a tumor or inhaled foreign body. Once airways are damaged, ineffective mucus clearance favors microbial persistence and infection; neutrophilic inflammation, tissue injury, and remodeling then worsen clearance, creating an infection–inflammation–damage cycle. Infection can therefore be both an initiating event and a later amplifier. COPD, asthma, or inflammatory bowel disease may coexist in adults, but coexistence does not establish the direct cause in every case. A substantial proportion remains idiopathic after systematic evaluation; disease confined to one lobe particularly warrants evaluation for focal obstruction.

cond.interstitial_lung_disease.etiology_zh: 間質性肺病（ILD）是病因與病理各異的疾病群，不是一個單一疾病。已知原因可分為環境／職業吸入暴露（石綿、矽、煤塵、黴菌、鳥類蛋白與其他有機粉塵）、自體免疫或結締組織疾病（如 systemic sclerosis、類風濕性關節炎、發炎性肌病）、藥物或胸部放射線傷害，以及部分感染後肺損傷。另有 sarcoidosis、遺傳性 surfactant 或 telomere-related disorders 等特定類型；有些 ILD 經完整評估仍屬特發性。不同起因可先造成肺泡上皮、間質、微血管或小氣道受傷；正常修復若失調，持續發炎、纖維母細胞活化與細胞外基質沉積便使肺變厚、變硬並降低氣體交換。並非所有 ILD 都以發炎為主，也並非所有病例都必然進展為不可逆纖維化。病因分類需整合暴露與職業史、藥物和放射史、自體免疫線索、HRCT 型態、肺功能及必要時 BAL 或病理；「ILD」標籤本身不能取代具體病因診斷。
cond.interstitial_lung_disease.etiology_en: Interstitial lung disease (ILD) is an etiologically and pathologically diverse disease family, not one disease. Known causes include environmental or occupational inhalation of asbestos, silica, coal dust, mold, bird proteins, and other organic dusts; autoimmune or connective-tissue disease such as systemic sclerosis, rheumatoid arthritis, or inflammatory myopathy; medicine toxicity or chest radiation; and selected postinfectious lung injuries. Other specific forms include sarcoidosis and inherited surfactant- or telomere-related disorders, while some ILDs remain idiopathic after a complete assessment. Different insults can injure alveolar epithelium, interstitium, microvasculature, or small airways. When repair becomes dysregulated, persistent inflammation, fibroblast activation, and extracellular-matrix deposition thicken and stiffen lung tissue and impair gas exchange. Not every ILD is predominantly inflammatory, and not every case inevitably progresses to irreversible fibrosis. Etiologic classification integrates exposure and occupational history, medicines and radiation, autoimmune features, HRCT pattern, pulmonary function, and selected bronchoalveolar lavage or pathology; the umbrella label “ILD” does not replace a specific cause diagnosis.

cond.idiopathic_pulmonary_fibrosis.etiology_zh: 特發性肺纖維化（IPF）按定義是排除其他已知原因後，仍無法確定起因的慢性纖維化間質性肺炎；不能因 CT 出現 UIP 型態就自動等同 IPF，因結締組織疾病、慢性過敏性肺炎、藥物或職業暴露也可呈現相似型態。目前模型認為，遺傳易感與老化肺泡上皮在反覆微小損傷後產生異常修復，驅動 fibroblast／myofibroblast 活化及過量基質沉積，而不只是單純持續性發炎。高齡、男性、吸菸與家族史會提高風險；部分家族或散發病例帶有 telomere maintenance、surfactant processing 等基因變異，常見 MUC5B promoter variant 也增加易感性，但帶有風險變異不表示必然發病。金屬或木粉塵、胃食道逆流和部分病毒曾被觀察到關聯，但現有資料不能證明它們是每位患者的直接原因。診斷必須先系統排除可辨識暴露、藥物與自體免疫疾病，再由臨床、HRCT 及必要時病理的 multidisciplinary discussion 確認。
cond.idiopathic_pulmonary_fibrosis.etiology_en: Idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF) is, by definition, a chronic fibrosing interstitial pneumonia whose initiating cause remains unknown after other causes have been excluded. A UIP pattern on CT is not automatically synonymous with IPF because connective-tissue disease, chronic hypersensitivity pneumonitis, medicines, and occupational exposures can produce similar patterns. The prevailing model is abnormal repair after repeated microscopic injury in genetically susceptible, aging alveolar epithelium, driving fibroblast and myofibroblast activation and excessive matrix deposition rather than simply persistent inflammation. Older age, male sex, smoking, and family history increase risk. Variants affecting telomere maintenance or surfactant processing occur in some familial and sporadic cases, and the common MUC5B promoter variant increases susceptibility, but a risk variant is not deterministic. Metal or wood dust, gastroesophageal reflux, and selected viral infections have been associated with IPF, but these observations do not prove a direct cause in every patient. Diagnosis requires systematic exclusion of identifiable exposure, medicine, and autoimmune causes, followed by multidisciplinary integration of clinical findings, HRCT, and pathology when needed.

cond.hypersensitivity_pneumonitis.etiology_zh: 過敏性肺炎是易感者反覆或高量吸入特定抗原後，肺部產生不適當免疫反應所致，而不是感染性肺炎或單純 IgE 型氣喘。來源包括黴菌與嗜熱放線菌污染的乾草、穀物或潮濕建築，鳥羽、糞便或其他動物蛋白，受污染的加濕器、空調、熱水池與金屬加工液，以及部分低分子量化學物。只有少數暴露者發病，顯示暴露強度、粒徑與持續時間、宿主免疫易感性及可能的遺傳／共因子共同決定疾病；找不到抗原並不排除診斷。反覆抗原到達細支氣管與肺泡後，細胞媒介免疫與免疫複合體相關反應造成小氣道和間質發炎；持續暴露可轉為組織重塑與纖維化。暴露後血清 specific IgG 只表示曾暴露與致敏，不能單獨證明疾病，也不能把陽性結果當作過敏原已確定。病因確認需把詳細住家、嗜好與職業史、症狀隨離開／回到環境的變化、HRCT、BAL 及必要時病理整合判讀。
cond.hypersensitivity_pneumonitis.etiology_en: Hypersensitivity pneumonitis is an inappropriate pulmonary immune response in a susceptible person after repeated or intense inhalation of a specific antigen; it is not infectious pneumonia or simply IgE-mediated asthma. Sources include mold or thermophilic actinomycetes in hay, grain, or damp buildings; bird feathers, droppings, and other animal proteins; contaminated humidifiers, ventilation systems, hot tubs, or metalworking fluid; and selected low-molecular-weight chemicals. Only a minority of exposed people develop disease, indicating that exposure dose, particle characteristics and duration, host immune susceptibility, and other cofactors interact; failure to identify an antigen does not exclude the diagnosis. Repeated antigen deposition in bronchioles and alveoli triggers cell-mediated and immune-complex-associated inflammation, and continued exposure can lead to remodeling and fibrosis. Serum antigen-specific IgG indicates exposure and sensitization but does not by itself prove disease or identify the causal antigen. Etiologic confirmation integrates detailed home, hobby, and occupational history; improvement away from and recurrence within an environment; HRCT; bronchoalveolar lavage; and pathology when needed.

cond.emphysema.etiology_zh: 肺氣腫是肺泡壁破壞與遠端氣腔永久擴大的病理型態，常是 COPD 的組成之一，但不等同所有 COPD。最主要的後天原因是長期吸入菸草煙霧；二手菸、室內生物燃料煙霧、空氣污染及職業粉塵或化學煙霧也可累積肺損傷。吸入刺激物引發氧化壓力與發炎細胞募集，使 protease 活性超過 antiprotease 保護，逐步破壞彈性纖維、肺泡隔與微血管床。少數病例由遺傳性 alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency 顯著促成：SERPINA1 相關 AAT 缺乏使肺失去對 neutrophil elastase 的保護，吸菸會大幅加速早發性、常偏全小葉型的氣腫；同一變異也可能因異常蛋白滯留而造成肝病。不是每位吸菸者都發病，也有從未吸菸者發病，顯示肺部成長、既往氣道疾病、遺傳易感與暴露總量共同影響。年輕、非吸菸、基底部為主或有家族性氣腫／肝病時應評估 AAT deficiency，而不能把所有氣腫都歸因於吸菸。
cond.emphysema.etiology_en: Emphysema is the pathologic pattern of alveolar-wall destruction and permanent enlargement of distal airspaces. It is often a component of COPD but is not synonymous with every form of COPD. The leading acquired cause is long-term tobacco-smoke inhalation. Secondhand smoke, indoor biomass smoke, air pollution, and occupational dust or chemical fumes can also accumulate lung injury. Inhaled irritants generate oxidative stress and recruit inflammatory cells, allowing protease activity to exceed antiprotease protection and progressively destroy elastic fibers, alveolar septa, and the capillary bed. A minority is strongly driven by inherited alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency: SERPINA1-related AAT deficiency removes protection against neutrophil elastase, and smoking markedly accelerates early, often panacinar emphysema; retention of abnormal protein can also cause liver disease. Not every smoker develops emphysema, and never-smokers can be affected, indicating contributions from lung development, prior airway disease, genetic susceptibility, and cumulative exposure. AAT deficiency should be assessed in young, never-smoking, basilar-predominant, or familial emphysema and when liver disease coexists, rather than attributing all emphysema to smoking.
